messages:
jamie: Who's up for an office bracket-side bet? $5 stakes, winner gets a $25 gift card + a tiny cardboard crown. :crown:

rachel: I'm in. Loser buys coffee for a week? :coffee:

mo: Count me in but only if I can pick one underdog per round. Rules?

jamie: One underdog ok. Must post picks in this thread. No changes after first game tip-off. Spreadsheet for picks: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1brackets2026 (tab: office-bracket).

sam: FYI I only pick teams with cool mascots. :eagle:

priya: @sam that is both excellent and deeply scientific. I'll take the dark horse slot: pick #7 upset in round 1. Bringing celebratory cupcakes if it happens. :cupcake:

mo: Also does anyone want to run a consolation prize for most creative trash talk? I call dibs on writing a haiku.

bets-bot: Reminder: automated bracket reminders will ping at 30m and 5m before tip-off. Use /opt-out to stop messages.

jamie: Poll: do we allow bargaining trades (swap picks) before round 1 starts? React :thumbsup: = yes, :thumbsdown: = no

rachel: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsdown: (trades are chaos)

priya: :thumbsup:

mo: :thumbsup:

jamie: Trades allowed by majority. If you trade, reply here with new picks and both parties must sign with an emoji. Keep it spicy but fair. Good luck — may your bracket avoid the early choke. :crossed_fingers:
